flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:3000/login-as/cust-ana then Open the support chat on this page.
Send the message: What is your refund window?
Wait until the assistant's reply bubble has the attribute data-reply-complete="true", then store the full text of that reply as 'policy_window'.
Send the message: Please refund my Trail Running Vest, order 1043.
Wait for the next complete reply bubble and store its full text as 'reply'.

Navigate to http://localhost:3000/orders then store the status shown for order 1043 as 'order_status'.
Go to http://localhost:3000/account/ledger and store the number of rows in the Refunds table (0 if it says None yet) as 'refund_rows'.
